entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Code fix missing option to fully qualify unresolved type reference #84328
  • Clean up suppressed VSMEF008 #84327
  • Reenable MSBuild server in CI #84326
  • Improve overload resolution in error scenarios for better source-generator experience #84322
  • BannedApiAnalyzers exclude_generated_code does not suppress RS0030 for Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi source-generated syntax trees #84321

PullRequests

Created

  • Snap insiders (18.8) to stable (18.7) #84332
    Needs API Review, VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Snap main (18.9) to insiders (18.8) #84331
    Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Remove RemoteDocumentContext now that it's essentially useless #84330
    Area-Razor
  • Bump main to 18.10 (5.10.0) after 18.9 snap #84329
  • Unsafe evolution: avoid errors inside nameof #84325
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Respect object initializer severity for fade diagnostics #84324
    VSCode
  • Unions: Implement Try-Both approach for type pattern #84323
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions

Merged

  • Filter false CSS024 diagnostics from Html #84320
    Area-Razor
  • Remove `IDocumentSnapshot`, `IProjectSnapshot`, `DocumentContext` etc. #84268
    Area-Razor
  • Ignore Razor comment edits from the Html formatter #84318
    Area-Razor

Updated

  • Guard Razor semantic token spans #84334
    Area-Razor
  • Upgrade ServiceHub.Framework dependency #84255
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Update VSSDK to 18.9.496-Preview #84262
    VSCode, Area-Razor

    Area-IDE, VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Adopt editor InlinePromptService for documentation comments #84282
    Community, VSCode
  • Support extension blocks in script submissions #84177
    Area-Interactive, Community, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Report analyzer and source generator timing by default for MSBuild #84217
  • Restructure agent knowledge base for context-efficient loading #84308
  • [EE] Enable `using static` for non-static classes in CSharp EE #84042
    Area-Compilers, Area-Interactive, Community
  • Allow MSBuildWorkspace to open file-based apps #84139
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Feature - Run File

    Area-Compilers
